parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or temporary authorization with STS.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. Get this ID from the URL of your organization page in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. Example: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number. Pages are numbered starting from 1. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Defaults to 20. Range: 1–100.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: The search keyword to match against tag names.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
The sort order. Defaults to updated\_desc.

- updated\_asc: Update time, ascending

- updated\_desc: Update time, descending

- name\_asc: Tag name, ascending

- name\_desc: Tag name, descending
